title: Building Systems That Listen: Rashida Lovely on AI, Reciprocity, and Coexisting With Technology
description: Rashida Lovely joins BIT Voices Podcast to explore a different way of thinking about technology, AI, and the systems that shape our future. From the Co-existence Co-efficient (Ce) protocol to the Web of Agreement (WOA) system, Rashida shares her vision for technology built around reciprocity, stewardship, and human-centered design rather than extraction.
